children.text: Robux prices on mint buttons with the Robux mark. Final prices (user, 2026-11-17): Gems 25 / 99 / 249 R$ = 25 / 110 / 300 Gems (1 roll = 5 Gems), Starter Pack = 100 Gems + bait + rod, Boosts 39 each, Starter Pack 49, VIP 149, Auto-Fish Pro 249, Infinite Bag 349, Extra Cast ≤299 (waits on C4). Starter Pack shows once after the first purchase or Lv.3, closes right away, no countdown. Store opens from the hub tile; a Rates link is required because Gems buy random rolls.
